headline: Strict Capacity Limits and Vehicle Entry Requirements
reservation: Island Beach State Park does not use a daily entry reservation system, but rangers close the gate when parking reaches capacity. Overnight stays are prohibited within the park; visitors must book separate coastal accommodations in nearby gateway towns like Seaside Park or Toms River. Mobile Sport Fishing Vehicle permits require specific equipment and an official check at the park office.

days.title: Atlantic Surf and Barrier Dunes

stops.name: Bathing Area 1
stops.detail: Arrive early at the primary swimming zone to secure a spot for Atlantic surf access and lifeguard-supervised swimming.

stops.name: Island Beach Interpretive Center
stops.detail: Explore educational exhibits on the Barnegat Peninsula's history and the rare barrier island ecosystem.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes to traverse the main road; conditions vary by park volume.
days.note: Stay on designated boardwalks to protect fragile dunes.

days.title: Bayside Marshes and Maritime Forest
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from the Park Entrance

stops.name: Sedge Island Marine Conservation Zone
stops.detail: Launch a kayak to explore tidal creeks and view diamondback terrapins in the salt marshes.

stops.name: Johnny Allen’s Cove Trail
stops.detail: Hike through stunted red cedar forests and holly trees shaped by coastal winds.

days.driving: Local transfer between bayside launch sites; allow 15 minutes.
days.note: Bayside areas can be significantly more buggy than the oceanfront.

days.title: Inlet Vistas and Coastal Birding

stops.name: Barnegat Inlet Jetty
stops.detail: Walk to the southern tip for views across the water to the historic Barnegat Lighthouse.

stops.name: Osprey Observation Blinds
stops.detail: Visit dedicated viewing stations to spot nesting birds of prey along the Barnegat Bay.

days.driving: Roughly 30 minutes from gateway cities to the park's southern end.
days.note: The walk to the inlet jetty is long and exposed; pace yourself.

intel.title: Entry Gate Closures
intel.text: Access is restricted once parking lots fill, common on summer weekends by mid-morning. Monitor the park's official social media or status site for real-time closure alerts.

intel.title: Gateway Supply Points
intel.text: Fuel and supplies are available in Seaside Park and Toms River. There are no gas stations or stores once you pass the main gate.

intel.title: Seasonal Pavilion Hours
intel.text: Bathing pavilions and concession stands typically operate from Memorial Day to Labor Day. Off-season visitors should bring their own food and water.

intel.title: Bathing Area Capacity
intel.text: Parking is strictly limited to paved lots at Bathing Areas 1 and 2. Once these areas reach their limit, vehicle entry is paused.

intel.title: Coastal Connectivity
intel.text: Cell service is generally stable along the main park road. However, reception may dip near the southern inlet or deep within the maritime forest.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental vehicle at Trenton Mercer (TTN), stock up on beach essentials in Toms River, and aim for an early morning arrival to beat potential gate closures.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the main paved road, but 4WD is required for beach driving; check all rental contract restrictions regarding sand.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset over Barnegat Bay from the Reed’s Road area, subject to seasonal sky conditions.
